name: gemi.nvim
description: AI-powered Neovim plugin for enhanced development workflow

scripts.build: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build:lua
scripts.build:lua: lua -e "print('Checking Lua syntax...')" && find lua plugin tests -name '*.lua' -exec luac -p {} \;
scripts.fix: bun run format && bun run lint
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.install-tools: bun run install:luacheck && bun run install:stylua
scripts.install:luacheck: if command -v luarocks >/dev/null 2>&1; then luarocks install luacheck; else echo 'Installing luacheck via package manager...'; fi
scripts.install:stylua: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo install stylua; elif command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then brew install stylua; else echo 'Please install stylua manually'; fi
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run package
scripts.package: VERSION=$(cat VERSION) && mkdir -p dist && tar -czf dist/gemi.nvim-$VERSION.tar.gz --exclude='.git*' --exclude='dist' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='*.log' --exclude='tests' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='Makefile' --exclude='.github' .
scripts.help: echo 'Available scripts: dev, build, lint, format, check, test, clean, install-tools, release'

author: nilptr
